newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed up by 0.47 percent driven by gains to non-banking shares, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 475.16 from 472.94 on Wednesday.
Volume was 2.27 million dinars against 2.75 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.29 million dinars and 961,536 dinars in over-the-counter exchanges.

Household firm Ateliers Mecanique du Sahel won 0.91 dinar to 10.92. Palm Beach Hotels gained 0.82 dinar to 9.82. Detergents firm SPCD was up 0.5 dinar to 25.58. Coke and beer bottler SFBT rose 0.24 dinar to 79.
Banque Nationale Agricole was unchanged at 30.86 dinars with 18,860 shares exchanged.
